help.title: Build your family tree
help.body: Add a person, then choose a placement. Tap a person card to edit, move, or connect a partner, parent, or child. Select a family when there is more than one relationship.
help.storage: Changes are held in this page’s memory. Use Save JSON to keep them, and Open JSON to resume later. Unplaced people are not saved.
help.exceptions: Automatic layout of exceptional generation or sibling-order conflicts is outside Version 1.
